an5.101:1.1: CI. Pañc'ime bhikkhave sekhavesārajjakaraṇadhammā. Katame pañca? Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu saddho hoti, sīlavā hoti, bahussuto hoti, āraddhaviriyo hoti, paññavā hoti.
an5.101:2.1: Yaṃ bhikkhave assaddhassa sārajjaṃ hoti, saddhassa taṃ sārajjaṃ na hoti. Tasmāyaṃ dhammo sekhavesārajjakaraṇo.
an5.101:3.1: Yaṃ bhikkhave dussīlassa sārajjaṃ hoti, sīlavato taṃ sārajjaṃ na hoti. Tasmāyaṃ dhammo sekhavesārajjakaraṇo.
an5.101:4.1: Yaṃ bhikkhave appassutassa sārajjaṃ hoti, bahussutassa taṃ sārajjaṃ na hoti. Tasmāyaṃ dhammo sekhavesārajjakaraṇo.
an5.101:5.1: Yaṃ bhikkhave kusītassa sārajjaṃ hoti, āraddhaviriyassa taṃ sārajjaṃ na hoti. Tasmāyaṃ dhammo sekhavesārajjakaraṇo.
an5.101:6.1: Yaṃ bhikkhave duppaññassa sārajjaṃ hoti, paññavato taṃ sārajjaṃ na hoti. Tasmāyaṃ dhammo sekhavesārajjakaraṇo. Ime kho bhikkhave pañca sekhavesārajjakaraṇadhammā ti.
